question: Why does initiation fail to bestow auspiciousness in these secluded cases?
premises: Forest dwellers and secluded ascetics are considered
Initiation is performed in such cases
Auspicious results are expected from initiation
inference: Initiation of a forest dweller or one in a secluded stage is not a bestower of auspiciousness.
plain_english: Initiation of a forest dweller or of one living in seclusion is not a bestower of auspiciousness.
